narrationTexts: Only order totals fail. Let me pull the exact 3 cases.
finalText:
**All 625 tests pass now.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Only rows with both a discount and a tax rate exposed it, so 3 of 66 `order totals` cases failed.

Fixed to tax the discounted amount. Suite is green, 625 passing, 0 failing.

Next: nothing.
